'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Mike Honsho LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Honsho]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet Fred/Mike Honcho → Mike Honsho. Deck title Hey Hey Hey! Plenum → Marketplace (OCR). All My Urchins (V) / Corellian Retort → Corellian Slip (V) may redlink. Landing Claw Alien Freighter noted as Landing Claw. Sheet ~10 shields.

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / Ambush|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
